text:
Zoe (CS): Quick flag — AetherGrid renewal next Thurs. They want to shorten from 12mo -> 6mo, add 20 seats, and request split invoicing across APAC (SG entity) and EU. Also asking if onboarding credit can be applied to the shortened term or allocated to the APAC invoice only. Any blockers?
Ibrahim (Sales): Price Q: they want same per-seat price for 6mo. If we keep price flat, revenue recognition may change. Check with finance.
Zoe (CS): Procurement insists on 2 invoices for their internal cost centers. They said APAC must be billed in SGD.
Clara (Legal): Split invoices fine. Need full legal names, VAT/GST numbers, and PO text. I can add a short amendment for term change and credit allocation language.
Jin (Billing): We can issue dual-currency invoices (SGD + EUR). To allocate onboarding credit to APAC-only, we need written approval. Our system treats credits at account level by default but can do one-off allocations if legal signs off.
Arjun (PM): Onboarding ask: customer wants a 14-day accelerated kickoff and a go-live checklist with 3 acceptance items. We can do 2 workshops + checklist.
Ibrahim (Sales): I'll try to keep unit price flat. If finance pushes, may need approval for amended term pricing.
Clara (Legal): I'll draft clause: "Onboarding credit (one-time) to be applied as follows: X to APAC invoice; remaining balance to be allocated pro rata across invoices." Will route via DocuSign.
BillingBot: Draft invoice snapshot:
```
AETHERGRID APAC (Entity A) - SGD 18,000 - 12 seats (6mo prorated)
AETHERGRID EU  (Entity B)   -  6,000 EUR - 8 seats (6mo prorated)
Onboarding credit: SGD 2,000 allocated to APAC; remainder to be split pro rata (pending amendment)
```
Zoe (CS): Timing note: Jin needs vendor codes + PO numbers (both entities) by Tue COB to hit next billing run and avoid month delay. Procurement warned APAC approvals might take 4 business days.
Jin (Billing): Confirmed. If POs arrive late, invoices will fall into next cycle. Also need billing contacts/emails.
Ibrahim (Sales): I'll request PO numbers, GST/VAT IDs, and billing emails now.
Zoe (CS): Action items:
- Ibrahim: collect POs, legal names, tax IDs (owner)
- Clara: draft amendment + DocuSign
- Jin: prepare dual-currency invoice templates and credit allocation flow
- Arjun: hold 2x 60-min kickoff slots week 1 post-sign and draft go-live checklist
I'll update renewal tracker and ping if APAC approvals look slow. Thanks all :rocket:
